title: Barcelona and the architecture
text: We loved our stay in Barcelona and the architecture. Still amazed by the churches. Our country India also has amazing architectural examples but it still leaves you in awe when you see Sagrada Familia. The trip didn't foresee going inside Sagrada Familia but we went later on our own. It was a nice trip. We organised France Spain and Greece trips with the same organiser and enjoyed our stay in Europe
author: Getaway35626605792
